card.name: Soldado Pinguim
card.summary: Veja as regras completas em português e os alvos selecionados antes da corrente.

textEvidence.text: Optional FLIP trigger, including after damage calculation when revealed by battle. Choose one to 2 activation-time targets from all monsters on either field, including face-down monsters and the source if it remains on the field. Return the still-eligible original targets to their physical owners hands simultaneously; Fusion monsters return to their owners Extra Deck instead. Each selected target has an independent zone-lifetime binding; a missing target never redirects the effect and does not prevent the other targets from resolving. The controller may decline activation; after acceptance at least one target is required. A source destroyed by battle is already absent and cannot choose itself. No activation cost, second effect, once-per-turn limit or continuing duration. Monster effect negation prevents resolution while applicable; removing the source alone does not negate it.
